incidents: FSSAI permits ethylene gas at up to 100 ppm for artificial ripening and lists ethephon (39% SL with alkali, or powder in sachets) among the permitted ethylene sources, on the condition that no source of ethylene gas comes into direct contact with the fruit. Carbide gas and acetylene are not permitted. An FSSAI direction of 16 Aug 2018 permitting ethephon was challenged in court (per a legal blog).
source: FSSAI Guidance Note: Artificial Ripening of Fruits (version 2, revised 10 Feb 2020)
note: Condition: the ethylene source, ethephon included, must not touch the fruit, so dipping or spraying fruit with ethephon is outside the permission. note_ms: Syarat: sumber etilena, termasuk etefon, tidak boleh menyentuh buah, jadi merendam atau menyembur buah dengan etefon berada di luar kebenaran ini. limit_type: temporary limits: 0.3 mg/kg for tropical fruits with inedible peel; 0.05 mg/kg for citrus
source: Commission Regulation (EU) 2020/749, Annex and Article 2 (EUR-Lex)
note: Chlorate is not approved as a pesticide in the EU. Reg (EU) 2020/749 replaced the 0.01 mg/kg default with temporary limits for every food, because residues come mainly from chlorinated water and disinfectants. Read from its Annex: citrus fruits 0.05; miscellaneous fruits with inedible peel, small (group 0162000, which includes litchi and passion fruit) 0.3; large (group 0163000: avocado, banana, mango, papaya, guava, pineapple, durian) 0.3. Longan is classed with litchi in the EU product list (not re-read here). Article 2 required a review by 8 June 2025; whether the values have since been amended was not checked. The limits were set for background contamination, not for potassium chlorate applied to longan.
limit_type_zh: 临时限量：果皮不可食的热带水果 0.3 mg/kg；柑橘 0.05 mg/kg
limit_type_ms: had sementara: 0.3 mg/kg bagi buah tropika berkulit tidak boleh dimakan; 0.05 mg/kg bagi sitrus
note_zh: 氯酸盐在欧盟未被批准为农药。Reg (EU) 2020/749 以针对所有食品的临时限量取代了 0.01 mg/kg 的默认值，因为残留主要来自含氯消毒的水和消毒剂。数值读自其附件：柑橘类水果 0.05；果皮不可食的其他水果，小型（0162000 组，包括荔枝和百香果）0.3；大型（0163000 组：牛油果、香蕉、芒果、木瓜、番石榴、菠萝、榴莲）0.3。在欧盟产品清单中龙眼与荔枝归为一类（此处未重新查阅）。第 2 条要求在 2025 年 6 月 8 日前复审；此后数值是否修订未作核对。这些限量针对的是背景污染，而不是在龙眼上施用氯酸钾。
note_ms: Klorat tidak diluluskan sebagai racun perosak di EU. Reg (EU) 2020/749 menggantikan had lalai 0.01 mg/kg dengan had sementara bagi setiap makanan, kerana residu berpunca terutamanya daripada air berklorin dan bahan pembasmi kuman. Dibaca daripada Lampirannya: buah sitrus 0.05; buah pelbagai berkulit tidak boleh dimakan, kecil (kumpulan 0162000, termasuk laici dan markisa) 0.3; besar (kumpulan 0163000: avokado, pisang, mangga, betik, jambu batu, nanas, durian) 0.3. Longan dikelaskan bersama laici dalam senarai produk EU (tidak dibaca semula di sini). Perkara 2 menghendaki semakan sebelum 8 Jun 2025; sama ada nilai telah dipinda selepas itu tidak disemak. Had ini ditetapkan untuk pencemaran latar, bukan untuk kalium klorat yang digunakan pada longan.

measured_fruit_residues: Thailand, roots treated with potassium chlorate. Fruit sampled 210 days later had chlorate up to 0.2254 mg/kg (960 g KClO3 per tree, highest dose). Untreated control fruit had 0.0326 mg/kg. Whole ready-to-eat fruit, UV spectrophotometric method. Authors judged consumption safe by margin of safety.
source: Baubhom T. and Chatsantiprapa K. (2019) Safety of out-of-season longan consumption, Isan J. Pharm. Sci. 15(2)
note: Both the treated fruit (up to 0.2254 mg/kg) and the untreated fruit (0.0326 mg/kg) are below the EU temporary chlorate limit of 0.3 mg/kg for this fruit group (Reg (EU) 2020/749); the 0.01 mg/kg default no longer applies to chlorate. The method (indigo carmine, UV 610 nm) is less specific than the LC-MS/MS used in official EU control.
measured_fruit_residues_zh: 泰国，根部施用氯酸钾。210天后采样的果实中氯酸盐最高达0.2254 mg/kg（每株960 g KClO3，最高剂量）。未处理的对照果实为0.0326 mg/kg。样品为可直接食用的整果，采用紫外分光光度法。作者按安全边际判断食用安全。
measured_fruit_residues_ms: Thailand, akar dirawat dengan kalium klorat. Buah yang disampel 210 hari kemudian mengandungi klorat sehingga 0.2254 mg/kg (960 g KClO3 sepokok, dos tertinggi). Buah kawalan tidak dirawat mengandungi 0.0326 mg/kg. Buah utuh sedia dimakan, kaedah spektrofotometri UV. Penulis menilai pemakanan selamat berdasarkan margin keselamatan.
note_zh: 处理果（最高 0.2254 mg/kg）和未处理果（0.0326 mg/kg）都低于欧盟对这类水果的氯酸盐临时限量 0.3 mg/kg（Reg (EU) 2020/749）；0.01 mg/kg 的默认值已不再适用于氯酸盐。该方法（靛蓝胭脂红，UV 610 nm）的专一性低于欧盟官方监管使用的 LC-MS/MS。
note_ms: Buah yang dirawat (sehingga 0.2254 mg/kg) dan buah yang tidak dirawat (0.0326 mg/kg) kedua-duanya di bawah had sementara klorat EU sebanyak 0.3 mg/kg bagi kumpulan buah ini (Reg (EU) 2020/749); had lalai 0.01 mg/kg tidak lagi terpakai kepada klorat. Kaedah ini (indigo karmin, UV 610 nm) kurang spesifik berbanding LC-MS/MS yang digunakan dalam kawalan rasmi EU.

incidents: No RASFF notification for chlorate in longan was found. RASFF June 2024 lists Thai longan for other residues, e.g. azoxystrobin 0.038 vs 0.01 mg/kg, which is not a PGR.
